title: Mann nach Gewalttat gesucht – Polizei bittet um Mithilfe

extraction.summaryEn: Police are seeking a suspect in connection with a group assault on a 36-year-old man in front of the S-Bahn station Alexanderplatz, in which the victim was stabbed in the thigh with a knife. The incident occurred on 29 April 2025 shortly before 22:30.
